What's new in DuckOS 1.0.90

• Swiping down on the home screen opens the quick menu again. DuckOS's home had been blocking Android's pull-down since DuckOS's own panel was replaced by Android's.
• Settings > Sound > Microphone > Test the microphone: listens for a moment the ways apps, calls and DuckAI do, and shows which of them hear you.
